### Added
- **A Minecraft 26.3 build.** Built against Fabric Loader 0.19.5 and Fabric API 0.160.5+26.3 (up from 0.19.3 and 0.152.1+26.2). The 26.2 and 26.1.2 builds carry on alongside it.

### Changed
- Item drops and velocity pushes in the dragon fight use the 26.3 API on that build; behaviour is unchanged.

### Fixed
- **The 26.3 build could not start a server.** Two of the End fight's loot tables gave their roll count as a bare range, which 26.3 no longer reads unless the range says it is uniform. They say so now; the 26.2 and 26.1.2 builds read either form.

releases.notes:
## The End portal advancement tree

A new advancement tab, on a purpur background, showing every offering the portal demands. The root unlocks the moment you join, so the whole checklist is visible from the start rather than appearing only once you stumble onto your first offering.

- **One advancement per offering**, all ten: Trident, Netherite Block, Sniffer Egg, Enchanted Golden Apple, Totem of Undying, Beacon, Mace, 16 Wither Roses, Conduit and Zombie Head. Each carries its ritual flavour text plus a hint about where to actually find the thing.
- The four that gate on a boss or a rare structure — Netherite Block, Beacon, Mace and the 16 Wither Roses — are **challenge** advancements; the rest are goals.
- **VanillaSkills players earn Skill Shards for these.** VanillaSkills 2.0 counts the `thp` namespace when awarding shards per advancement, so finishing the tab is worth 110 Skill Shards at its default rates. THP remains completely standalone — without VanillaSkills installed these are simply advancements.
- Traditional Chinese (zh_tw) translations for all 22 new strings, keeping both languages complete at 68 keys.

Built for **MC 26.2** and **MC 26.1.2** (Fabric).

releases.notes:
### Added
- **Full localization support** — every player-facing string (portal ritual titles & chat, the offering list, command feedback, and the Mod Menu config screen) is now translatable. English is the built-in default; see `TRANSLATING.md` to add a language.

### Notes
- **MC 26.1.2 parity restored**: `thp-2.1.1+mc26.1.2.jar` brings the 26.1.2 build fully up to date with the 26.2 build (the custom 5-phase RogueCraft End fight + full localization), which had previously fallen behind at 2.0.0.

### Added
- **A custom, multi-phase Ender Dragon fight** — after the portal ritual is complete, the first entry into the End generates a custom arena (vanilla fight suppressed, vanilla island cleared) and an overhauled dragon boss: aerial barrages, the shulker-summoning "Hyper Jean" phase, a wave-based add fight, and a healing-crystal finale.
- On victory, the **exit portal lights inside the arena's central fountain** and full vanilla **End gateways** appear — go home, explore the outer End.
- **Vanilla-style revival**: rest 4 End Crystals on the obsidian pads around the portal to respawn the dragon and fight again.

### Changed
- **Offerings**: Recovery Compass replaced by **16 Wither Roses** (partial stacks count and are returned on timeout); Pigstep Music Disc replaced by a **Conduit**.
- `/thp portalreq` prints to chat only; the on-screen sequence plays when jumping into an unopened portal.

### Notes
- The End fight is derived from [RogueCraft](https://modrinth.com/datapack/rogue-craft) by MonoCode, used under **CC-BY-SA-4.0** (see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Wave mobs use base vanilla stats.
